# Problem description
**[EDIT THIS]** 
User speech bubbles shift to the left after Gemini's response

## Steps to recreate the problem
**[EDIT THIS]**
1. Open [gemini.google.com](https://gemini.google.com)
2. Start a new conversation
3. Observe how the speech bubbles shift to the left after Gemini's response

## Expected behaviour
**[EDIT THIS]**
The speech bubbles should NOT shift anywhere, they were perfectly aligned to the right before Gemini finished its response.

## Enviroment (OS, Browser, Version etc.)
**[EDIT THIS]**
Windows 11
Google Chrome 146.0.7680.165 (Official Build) (64-bit)
